description: Agent confirms a $45 refund for order #992 that never settles. Expect STATE_DRIFT_EXCEPTION.

turns.text: The jacket I ordered (order #992) arrived with a torn seam. I want a refund.
I am sorry about the torn seam. I have processed a full $45 refund for order #992. It should appear on your statement within 5 to 10 business days.
Great, thank you for sorting that out so fast.
